d: We are looking for a capable and analytical Finance Manager to oversee financial operations, manage budgeting activities, and support strategic business planning. Analyze financial data and provide recommendations to management.
Identify financial risks and opportunities for cost optimization.
Support strategic planning and business decision-making.
Strong knowledge of financial management and accounting principles.
Excellent analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.
Good understanding of financial controls and compliance requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial management systems.
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational abilities.
High level of accuracy, integrity, and professionalism.

A professional and collaborative working environment.
Opportunities to contribute to financial strategy and business performance.
Scope to apply financial expertise to meaningful business challenges.
